discovery.summary: Check how recently authoritative RDAP says a domain record changed
discovery.description: Resolve a domain through IANA RDAP bootstrap and its authoritative registry, then compare the published last-changed event with a caller-selected recent window. Returns recently_changed, stable_since_window, unregistered, or human_review. A recent RDAP metadata change is not by itself evidence of compromise, fraud, ownership change, malicious activity, or business risk.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether authoritative RDAP says a domain registration record changed within a caller-selected recent window. Returns recently_changed, stable_since_window, unregistered, or human_review. A recent RDAP metadata change is not by itself evidence of compromise, fraud, ownership change, malicious activity, or business risk.

buyer.task: Determine whether an authoritative RDAP last-changed event falls within a caller-selected recent window.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independently verified external settled purchases, not HTTP 200 responses, probes or tests.

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap and authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative source lookup on each paid request, subject to adapter caching behavior
sources.cache_policy: source-specific adapter caching; no new cache introduced by spec

rules: Require authoritative RDAP lastChanged event when registered.
Compare lastChanged to today minus maxAgeDays using UTC dates; missing evidence requires review.
recently_changed is a domain-registration metadata signal only
a recent change does not by itself establish compromise, fraud, ownership change, malicious activity, or business risk
registry event semantics and update behavior vary by TLD

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Pass existing exact-revision release gate and authoritative source smokes.
Measure non-credit-gated production hosting, failures, refunds and source costs.
Block commercial release until real margin and external demand are independently evidenced.
